_comment: freecad-mcp v0.2.0 - LOCAL / stdio registration. Merge the mcpServers block
below into claude_desktop_config.json (or your client's equivalent).
KEEP THE SERVER KEY 'freecad'. Existing harness allowlists, hooks and tool
ids are keyed on it; renaming it silently invalidates all of them.
TRANSPORT IS stdio, which is why this is a command + args block and not a
url. There is no HTTP endpoint in this server and none is built: the MCP
server is a loopback XML-RPC client of a GUI process on 127.0.0.1:9875, and
BC-06 (the client dies with its parent) is defined in terms of stdin EOF,
a signal that only exists under stdio.
INSTALL THE ADDON FIRST. This client is deliberately REFUSED by a v0.1.23
addon; the v0.2.0 addon still serves a v0.1.23 client. Order: addon ->
restart FreeCAD -> verify -> swap this command path. See README.md.
Every value in env is a PLACEHOLDER. There are no secrets in this server:
no token, key or licence value exists anywhere in it.
Both env entries are OPTIONAL. Drop either one to take its default
(localhost / 9875). FREECAD_MCP_FREECADCMD is only needed when freecadcmd
is not on PATH; quote the path if it contains spaces. The two addon-side
here - they are read inside the FreeCAD process, not this one.

env.FREECAD_MCP_HOST: <HOST OF THE FREECAD ADDON, e.g. localhost>
env.FREECAD_MCP_PORT: <XML-RPC PORT OF THE FREECAD ADDON, e.g. 9875>
